author: Legoche
body:
Hello!
Supply has been remade. Thank you for all the feedback given on this thread.

Gametype/Information:
TDM with no scoreboxes, features one gapple spawner which spawns one gapple every five seconds, two arrow spawners - one close to the spawn which spawns one arrow every second and one which overlooks middle which spawns one arrow every three seconds.

Images

Overview

YML - Coming Soon

Download - Private

Special thanks to:
Xuph
ImRaging
alexanderjoe

If you want to view it ingame, go on alexanderjoe's build server and type /mv tp SupplyTDMVoid

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Thanks for listening to my feedback about the gapple spawner, the change you made works really well as well as the two arrow spawners with different rates. 
Unlike maps such as Plaza I doubt large pushes will occur; as there is no scorebox; so mid control will be vital. 

Great remake and I hope it's accepted!
